title: Weighted Clifford-star control yields one factor-two canonical classical comparator

statement.quantifiers: Every finite supplied anticommuting Hermitian-involution span, supplied CPTP unital HS-selfadjoint self-compatible channel and legal broadcaster.
statement.assertion: One full-domain canonical EB Psi satisfies tau[A(I−Psi)A]<=2 tau[A(I−Phi)A] simultaneously for all A in the Clifford span, using at most2k+1 outcomes.
assumptions: Pairwise anticommutation, traceless tau-orthonormal generators and k>=2.
Equal broadcaster marginals and the stated channel contract; no HS-positive-spectrum assumption needed.

inputs: Exact Gamma matrices, compressed real symmetric T and a legal joint channel.
outputs: Explicit mixture of rotated-axis dephasings and the depolarizer; restricted trace-family corollary.
interface.precision: Exact simultaneous quadratic-form inequality. Finite-bit/hardware implementation not acquired.
costs: k² Hilbert-Schmidt scores, dense k-diagonalization and2k+1 effects charged.
Broadcaster and basis supplied, not learned by the proof.

proof_mechanism: Commuting star-sign algebra reduces to central Pauli blocks and a J-minus spectrum.
Layer-cake weighted bound sumw+maxw controls every subset of diagonal compressed eigenvalues.
Legal joint Choi expectation gives sum(2lambda−1)_+<=1.
Use these weights in canonical dephasing effects t_i(I plus/minus Gamma_i)/2 and a residual identity outcome.
Compressed comparator dominates2T−I without applying a positive-part map to the entire channel.
obstructions: Arbitrary observables need the unrestricted ensemble support inequality and one common POVM.
The seven-cycle EB example makes whole-channel positive-part rounding nonpositive; it is not a classicality counterexample.
Clifford monogamy/Pauli ingredients have substantial prior art; external correctness/novelty unverified.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove the all-positive-frame deficit inequality under all legal Choi marginal constraints; matched Clifford stars alone are insufficient.

review.source_reported: Source separate internal reconstructions and scoped exact checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
